purpose: Defines the zero-copy streaming ingestion engine, auto-fingerprinting detector, and orchestrator adapters for parsing Claude Code, Antigravity (AGY), Codex, and OpenCode session logs into CanonicalTranscript representations.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-session: SessionAdapter trait, AdapterCapabilities, fingerprint detection, ClaudeCodeAdapter, AgyAdapter, CodexAdapter, OpenCodeAdapter, PreCompact snapshot merge, and IngestionError.
non_goals: Database persistence, schema migrations, or queue supervisors (delegated to session-daemon).
Evaluation assertion grading or pass/fail decisions (delegated to prism-grader).

api_surface.name: SessionAdapter
api_surface.signature: pub trait SessionAdapter: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn matches_fingerprint(&self, sample: &str) -> bool; fn capabilities(&self) -> AdapterCapabilities; fn parse_stream<'a>(&self, reader: Box<dyn BufRead + 'a>) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript, IngestionError>; }
api_surface.description: Streaming parser trait implemented by orchestrator adapters to project newline-delimited logs into CanonicalTranscript.
error_conditions: IngestionError::MalformedJson if JSON line fails to parse
IngestionError::UnrecognizedFormat if log sample does not match known orchestrators

api_surface.name: AdapterCapabilities
api_surface.signature: pub struct AdapterCapabilities { pub has_token_usage: bool, pub has_tool_results: bool, pub has_shell_commands: bool, pub has_file_events: bool, pub has_lifecycle_hooks: bool, pub supports_incremental_offsets: bool, pub supports_cost_estimation: bool }
api_surface.description: Observability declaration exposing what telemetric capabilities are supported by the target orchestrator.

api_surface.name: detect_orchestrator
api_surface.description: Sub-millisecond fingerprint detector inspecting the first 2048 bytes of a session log to identify Claude Code, AGY, Codex, or OpenCode.
error_conditions: Returns None if byte sample contains insufficient or ambiguous headers

api_surface.name: merge_precompact_snapshots
api_surface.description: Applies the max() cumulative token merge invariant across pre-compaction snapshots to prevent double-counting on compacted sessions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN a session file starts with Claude Code permission or mode headers, THE SYSTEM SHALL identify the orchestrator as OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode in under 1 millisecond.
WHEN a session file starts with AGY step_index and source headers, THE SYSTEM SHALL identify the orchestrator as OrchestratorKind::Antigravity in under 1 millisecond.
WHEN ClaudeCodeAdapter parses an assistant message containing tool_use blocks, THE SYSTEM SHALL extract tool_name, call_id, and typed ToolIntent in the CanonicalTurn.
WHEN ClaudeCodeAdapter parses message.usage, THE SYSTEM SHALL extract input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens.
WHEN merging pre-compaction snapshots, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute input_tokens = max(final_input, max(snapshot_inputs)) and cache_read_tokens = max(final_cache_read, max(snapshot_cache_reads)).
IF a JSONL log contains corrupted, truncated, or non-UTF8 lines, THE SYSTEM SHALL skip the malformed line, record a warning, and continue parsing without panicking.
WHEN subagent metadata files (*.meta.json) exist in the subagents/ directory, THE SYSTEM SHALL link each child subagent transcript to its parent tool_use_id and record its spawnDepth.
WHEN AgyAdapter parses a PLANNER_RESPONSE step containing thinking blocks, THE SYSTEM SHALL extract the reasoning text into CanonicalTurn.text.
IF an empty session file is supplied, THE SYSTEM SHALL return a valid CanonicalTranscript with 0 turns and 0 token usage without erroring.
WHEN memory-mapped file parsing is requested on a 50MB session file, THE SYSTEM SHALL parse all turns in under 35 milliseconds.

reasoning: Establishes zero-copy streaming ingestion across multi-orchestrator log formats with snapshot merging and subagent tree resolution.
